## Key Guidelines
1. Follow best practices and idiomatic patterns.
2. Maintain existing code structure and organization.
3. Do NOT change or remove colors.
4. Do NOT over-complicate simple code, if it is working.
5. DO NOT Update to use new icecream 2025 API: switch on *msg using Msg:: enum class values instead of msg->type with legacy M_* constants, unless I specifically as for it.
